mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, actor, actor_user_id, operation_type, environment, system_code, module_code, target_id, request_hash, expected_revision, result_revision, source_item_id, reason, status, total_count, completed_count, success_count, failed_count, execution_token, lease_until, result_json, target_snapshot_json, new_ai_task_id, new_ai_item_id, create_time, update_time, finish_time FROM tb_ai_log_management_operation WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT id, request_id, actor, actor_user_id, operation_type, target_id, source_item_id, status, total_count, completed_count, success_count, failed_count, execution_token, lease_until, result_json, target_snapshot_json, create_time, update_time, finish_time FROM tb_ai_log_management_operation WHERE target_id = #{taskId} AND operation_type IN ('AI_GROUP_RERUN','AI_TASK_RERUN') AND status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_management_operation operation SET operation.execution_token = #{executionToken}, operation.lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, operation.update_time = #{now} WHERE operation.id = #{operationId} AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' AND (operation.execution_token IS NULL OR operation.lease_until < #{now}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item WHERE item.rerun_operation_id = operation.id AND item.rerun_status = 'RUNNING' AND item.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND item.lease_until >= #{now} )

UPDATE tb_ai_log_management_operation operation LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rerun_operation_id, SUM(CASE WHEN rerun_status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rerun_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rerun_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} GROUP BY rerun_operation_id ) progress ON progress.rerun_operation_id = operation.id SET operation.completed_count = COALESCE(progress.completed_count, 0), operation.success_count = COALESCE(progress.success_count, 0), operation.failed_count = COALESCE(progress.failed_count, 0), operation.update_time = #{now} WHERE operation.id = #{operationId} AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' AND operation.execution_token = #{executionToken}

UPDATE tb_ai_log_management_operation operation SET operation.status = CASE WHEN operation.failed_count > 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END, operation.result_json = #{resultJson}, operation.execution_token = NULL, operation.lease_until = NULL, operation.finish_time = #{now}, operation.update_time = #{now} WHERE operation.id = #{operationId} AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' AND operation.execution_token = #{executionToken} AND operation.completed_count = operation.total_count AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item WHERE item.rerun_operation_id = operation.id AND item.rerun_status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING') )

UPDATE tb_ai_log_management_operation SET status = 'FAILED', result_json = #{resultJson}, execution_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finish_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{operationId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token IS NULL

UPDATE tb_ai_log_management_operation operation SET operation.status = 'FAILED', operation.result_json = #{resultJson}, operation.execution_token = NULL, operation.lease_until = NULL, operation.finish_time = #{now}, operation.update_time = #{now} WHERE operation.id = #{operationId} AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' AND operation.execution_token = #{executionToken} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item WHERE item.rerun_operation_id = operation.id AND item.rerun_status = 'RUNNING' )
mapper.select: SELECT operation.id FROM tb_ai_log_management_operation operation WHERE operation.operation_type IN ('AI_GROUP_RERUN','AI_TASK_RERUN') AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' AND (operation.execution_token IS NULL OR operation.lease_until < #{now}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item WHERE item.rerun_operation_id = operation.id AND item.rerun_status = 'RUNNING' AND item.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND item.lease_until >= #{now} ) ORDER BY operation.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
